{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing systematic undershoot that corrects toward mean over time",
    "Forecasts exhibit excessive volatility compared to historical price movement, indicating overshooting micro-level fluctuations",
    "Sentiment positive (≥0.67) correlates with model being below current prices, while negative sentiment allows slightly higher forecasts",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes increases from day 1-10 (≈1.5-2.0) to day 11-20 (≈2.5-3.0), showing lag accumulation",
    "When history shows price consolidation (variance <1.0), model forecasts over-smooth and miss the final breakout to true outcomes",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative (0.67→0.00) precedes model forecasts that are still 1-2 ticks above reality, showing delayed sentiment assimilation",
    "Model appears to use a linear extrapolation from the last 6-8 data points, which fails at turning points where prices revert to simpler trends"
] }
